svg.text: Network topology across the Divi AWS accounts — VPCs, CIDRs, VPN and peering
VPC-level view of divi-ai-prod, divi-ai-stg, shared and rb-main · snapshot 2026-11-15 from read-only AWS API calls
ALB divi-prod-public · internet-facing · spans the three public subnets · SG divi-prod-public-alb (80/443)
Private route tables: 0.0.0.0/0 → NAT instance ENI · 192.168.0.0/24 → VGW
No VPC endpoints · no VPC flow logs · security groups: see appendix
ALB divi-stg-public · internet-facing · spans the three public subnets · SG divi-stg-public-alb (80/443)
Private route tables: 0.0.0.0/0 → NAT instance ENI · 192.168.0.0/24 → VGW · 10.40.0.0/16 → pcx
No VPC endpoints · no VPC flow logs · security groups: see appendix
3 public /20 subnets, IGW igw-0356c44ff30c4454b — no workloads
ECR is reached via its regional public endpoint: prod and stg
tasks pull images through their NAT instances (no VPC endpoints)
10.40.0.0/16 peer VPC in account 156358246875, peered to divi-stg only
192.168.0.0/24 Nocelle customer network, reached over one site-to-site VPN per environment (static routes, 2 tunnels each)
172.31.0.0/16 default VPCs in prod (vpc-057d805d64b10952d), stg (vpc-069f67711034e5621), shared and rb-main (×2) — unused, overlapping, not connected
Egress: private subnets default-route to NAT *instances* (t3.nano, one per AZ), not NAT Gateways
Ingress: single internet-facing ALB per VPC (public subnets) · OpenVPN on divi-<env>-vpn (UDP 1194, TCP 443)
Not present in any of the four accounts: Transit Gateway, VPC endpoints, Route 53 hosted zones/resolver endpoints, VPC flow logs
